contact.heading: You bring the problem. I'll bring the solution.
contact.description: Share what you are building, what is not working and what outcome matters. I'll respond directly to discuss fit and next steps.
contact.subject: Project inquiry
contact.body:
Hi Jason,

process.title: Discuss the problem
process.description: We review the business objective, affected systems, constraints and what a useful result would look like.

process.title: Agree on scope
process.description: I outline the technical approach, deliverables, responsibilities, acceptance criteria and commercial terms for review before work begins.

process.title: Build and verify
process.description: Implementation proceeds against the agreed scope, with visible progress and checks aligned to the work.

process.title: Deliver and hand off
process.description: The engagement closes with the agreed source, documentation and knowledge transfer, plus any separately agreed support.
